en.tagline: Dengue early warning from rain, heat and recent cases. Act weeks before hospitals fill.
en.origin: Forecast made in the week ending
en.replay_note: Replay: these forecasts were made by models trained only on earlier years, so they show what EpiLag would have said at the time.
en.hits: Areas that actually crossed the epidemic threshold
en.as_of: Forecast made from the week ending
en.warning_d: Middle forecast above the epidemic threshold
en.watch_d: Upper forecast above the epidemic threshold
en.above_d: Higher than usual for this time of year
en.rank_sub: Forecast cases per 100,000 people, highest first
en.why_note: Contribution to the forecast (log scale). Positive pushes the forecast up.
en.cost: Cost per person covered (PHP, example value)
en.qc_note: Weekly forecasts are city-wide. Barangay data is yearly only, so the city forecast is shared out by each barangay's share of cases in 2022-2025.
en.quiet: Quiet week: no area needs outbreak action.
en.then_line: areas that crossed the epidemic threshold were flagged {h} weeks ahead.
en.story_note: EpiLag-PH reads this week's rain and cases and warns at week 0, so LGUs can clean up and stock supplies before the peak.
en.features_sub: Each tool, what it does, and why it matters.
en.brief_sub: Areas on watch or warning, highest risk per 100,000 first.
en.brief_empty: No area is on watch or warning for this week. Keep routine surveillance; the areas above usual are listed for follow-up.
en.peak: peak forecast in the week ending
en.prepare: Plan for up to {n} cases in the next 8 weeks
en.proof_sub: Each test year was forecast only from earlier years (no peeking). Lower error is better.
en.beat: test sets where it beat both simple rules {h} weeks ahead
en.caught_share: of outbreak starts caught {h} weeks ahead (watch level)
en.coverage: of real values inside the likely range (target 80%)
en.err_chart: Average error per area-week, {h} weeks ahead
en.weather_note: Honest result: most of the skill comes from recent cases and season. Weather adds a modest gain at 4-8 weeks in some years and none in others, so EpiLag works with data LGUs already have.
en.plan_sub: Ranks where each peso prevents the most forecast cases over the next 8 weeks. Costs are example values: replace them with your LGU's own costs.

en.outbreak warning: Outbreak warning: cases are forecast above the epidemic threshold. Start clean-up drives now, pre-position test kits, and alert hospitals.
en.watch: Watch: an outbreak is possible. Check breeding sites this week and prepare teams.
en.above usual: Above usual: cases are forecast higher than normal for this time of year. Keep watch.

fil.outbreak warning: Babala ng outbreak: inaasahang lalampas ang kaso sa threshold ng epidemya. Simulan na ang paglilinis, ihanda ang test kits, at abisuhan ang mga ospital.
fil.watch: Bantayan: posible ang outbreak. Suriin ang mga pinamumugaran ng lamok ngayong linggo at ihanda ang mga team.
fil.above usual: Mas mataas sa karaniwan: mas maraming kaso ang inaasahan kaysa karaniwan sa panahong ito. Patuloy na magbantay.

outbreak warning: Convene the local dengue task force and barangay health teams; issue a public advisory.
Which areas, how many cases (with a range), and the week of the peak.
Run clean-up drives and cover water containers in the top barangays; larvicide where needed.
The budget split by cases averted per peso, and the QC barangay shortlist.
Stock NS1 rapid tests and IV fluids; ask hospitals to open dengue fast lanes.
The upper forecast to size supplies: up to {n} cases in 8 weeks.
watch: Inspect and destroy breeding sites; check test-kit and IV-fluid stocks.
An early signal weeks ahead, before reported cases rise.
Prepare clean-up teams and messages so they can start within days.
The likely range, so you can plan for the high case: up to {n} cases in 8 weeks.
Re-check the forecast. If the middle forecast passes the threshold, escalate to outbreak response.
A weekly update with the reasons behind any change.
above usual: Remind households of the DOH 4S: search and destroy breeding sites, self-protect, seek early consultation, support fogging only in hotspots.
Which areas are trending above their usual level.
The forecast, range and threshold in one chart.
normal: Keep routine surveillance and community clean-ups.
Confirmation that no unusual rise is expected.

outbreak warning: Tipunin ang dengue task force at mga barangay health team; maglabas ng abiso sa publiko.
Aling mga lugar, ilang kaso (may saklaw), at kailan ang rurok.
Maglinis at takpan ang mga lalagyan ng tubig sa mga nangungunang barangay; maglagay ng larvicide kung kailangan.
Ang hati ng budget ayon sa kasong naiiwasan bawat piso, at ang listahan ng barangay sa QC.
Mag-imbak ng NS1 rapid test at IV fluids; hilingin sa mga ospital na magbukas ng dengue fast lane.
Ang mataas na forecast para sukatin ang gamit: hanggang {n} kaso sa 8 linggo.
watch: Suriin at sirain ang mga pinamumugaran ng lamok; tingnan ang stock ng test kit at IV fluids.
Maagang senyales ilang linggo bago tumaas ang naiulat na kaso.
Ihanda ang mga team sa paglilinis at ang mga mensahe para makapagsimula sa loob ng ilang araw.
Ang malamang na saklaw para makapaghanda sa pinakamataas: hanggang {n} kaso sa 8 linggo.
Balikan ang forecast. Kapag lumampas sa threshold ang gitnang forecast, itaas sa outbreak response.
Lingguhang update kasama ang dahilan ng anumang pagbabago.
above usual: Ipaalala sa mga tahanan ang 4S ng DOH: hanapin at sirain ang pinamumugaran, protektahan ang sarili, magpakonsulta agad, suportahan ang fogging sa hotspot lamang.
Aling mga lugar ang mas mataas kaysa karaniwan.
Ang forecast, saklaw at threshold sa iisang tsart.
normal: Ituloy ang karaniwang pagbabantay at paglilinis ng komunidad.
Kumpirmasyon na walang inaasahang di-pangkaraniwang pagtaas.

map: Colours every area by alert level 2–8 weeks ahead, with a likely range.
Dengue rises 4–8 weeks after the rains, and case reports arrive late.
Pick the areas that need action first.
unit: Shows the forecast against the epidemic threshold, the history, and the reasons.
A clear reason makes an alert easier to trust and to defend to the mayor.
Follow a week-by-week checklist and download a brief.
budget: Splits your budget across areas and actions by cases averted per peso.
Money is limited; acting where risk is highest prevents the most cases.
Get a funded plan you can export and present.
qc: Turns the Quezon City forecast into a barangay shortlist.
Clean-up teams work barangay by barangay.
Send teams to the top barangays first.
proof: Forecasts past years using only earlier years, against simple rules.
Trust is earned with honest tests, including what did not work.
Check hit rates and false alarms before relying on it.
public: Tells residents, in plain English or Filipino, whether dengue is rising where they live.
Households remove most breeding sites; they act sooner when warned in words they understand.
Share a ready-made advisory with your barangay group chat.
about: Lists every data source, the method and the known limits.
Decisions need to know what the numbers can and cannot say.
Cite the sources and explain the caveats.

map: Kinukulayan ang bawat lugar ayon sa antas ng babala, 2–8 linggo bago, may malamang na saklaw.
Tumataas ang dengue 4–8 linggo matapos ang ulan, at huli dumating ang ulat ng kaso.
Piliin ang mga lugar na unang kikilusan.
unit: Ipinapakita ang forecast laban sa threshold ng epidemya, ang kasaysayan, at ang mga dahilan.
Mas madaling pagkatiwalaan at ipagtanggol sa alkalde ang babalang may malinaw na dahilan.
Sundin ang checklist bawat linggo at i-download ang buod.
budget: Hinahati ang budget sa mga lugar at gawain ayon sa kasong naiiwasan bawat piso.
Limitado ang pondo; mas maraming kaso ang naiiwasan kung uunahin ang pinakamapanganib.
Kumuha ng planong may pondo na maaaring i-export at iharap.
qc: Ginagawang listahan ng barangay ang forecast ng Quezon City.
Bawat barangay ang pinupuntahan ng mga team sa paglilinis.
Ipadala muna ang mga team sa mga nangungunang barangay.
proof: Hinuhulaan ang mga nakaraang taon gamit lamang ang mga naunang taon, laban sa simpleng tuntunin.
Nakukuha ang tiwala sa tapat na pagsubok, kasama ang hindi gumana.
Tingnan ang tama at maling babala bago umasa rito.
public: Sinasabi sa mga residente, sa simpleng Filipino o Ingles, kung tumataas ang dengue sa kanilang lugar.
Ang mga tahanan ang nag-aalis ng karamihan ng pinamumugaran; mas maagang kumikilos kapag binalaan sa salitang naiintindihan.
Ibahagi ang handang abiso sa group chat ng barangay.
about: Nakalista ang bawat pinagkunan ng datos, ang pamamaraan at ang mga limitasyon.
Kailangang alam ng nagpapasya kung ano ang kaya at hindi kayang sabihin ng numero.
Banggitin ang pinagkunan at ipaliwanag ang mga paalala.

en.head: Dengue in your area
en.sub: A plain-language outlook from EpiLag-PH, with what your household can do this week.

status.outbreak warning: Dengue is likely to rise sharply in {area} in the next {h} weeks.
status.watch: Dengue may rise in {area} in the next {h} weeks.
status.above usual: Dengue cases in {area} are a little higher than usual for this time of year.
status.normal: No unusual rise in dengue is expected in {area} in the next {h} weeks.

en.do_head: What your household can do this week (DOH 4S)
do: Cover water drums and pails. Empty and scrub vases, plant saucers and old tires every week. Clear roof gutters.
Wear long sleeves and pants, use mosquito repellent, and sleep under a net or behind screens, especially at dawn and dusk.
Fever for 2 days? Go to your health center. Do not wait for a rash.
Fogging does little on its own. Removing breeding sites matters more.
en.signs_head: Go to the hospital now if someone with dengue has:
signs: Bleeding from the gums or nose
en.share_head: Share with your barangay group chat
en.msg: Dengue outlook for {area} (EpiLag-PH, forecast for the week ending {week}): {status} This week: cover water containers, empty vases and old tires, use repellent, and see a doctor after 2 days of fever. romeo-04.github.io/epilag
en.note: Forecasts can be wrong; they show what is likely, not certain. For medical advice, ask your health center.

fil.head: Dengue sa inyong lugar
fil.sub: Simpleng pananaw mula sa EpiLag-PH, at ang magagawa ng inyong pamilya ngayong linggo.

status.outbreak warning: Malamang na tumaas nang malaki ang dengue sa {area} sa susunod na {h} linggo.
status.watch: Maaaring tumaas ang dengue sa {area} sa susunod na {h} linggo.
status.above usual: Medyo mas mataas kaysa karaniwan ang kaso ng dengue sa {area} sa panahong ito.
status.normal: Walang inaasahang di-pangkaraniwang pagtaas ng dengue sa {area} sa susunod na {h} linggo.

fil.do_head: Ang magagawa ng inyong pamilya ngayong linggo (4S ng DOH)
do: Takpan ang mga drum at timba. Linggo-linggong alisan ng laman at kuskusin ang mga plorera, platito ng halaman at lumang gulong. Linisin ang alulod.
Magsuot ng mahabang manggas at pantalon, gumamit ng mosquito repellent, at matulog sa kulambo o may screen, lalo na sa madaling-araw at dapit-hapon.
Dalawang araw nang may lagnat? Pumunta sa health center. Huwag hintayin ang pantal.
Kaunti lang ang naitutulong ng fogging. Mas mahalaga ang pag-alis ng pinamumugaran.
fil.signs_head: Dalhin agad sa ospital kung ang may dengue ay may:
fil.share_head: Ibahagi sa group chat ng barangay
fil.msg: Lagay ng dengue sa {area} (EpiLag-PH, forecast para sa linggong magtatapos sa {week}): {status} Ngayong linggo: takpan ang mga lalagyan ng tubig, alisan ng laman ang mga plorera at lumang gulong, gumamit ng repellent, at magpakonsulta pagkatapos ng 2 araw na lagnat. romeo-04.github.io/epilag
fil.note: Maaaring magkamali ang forecast; ipinapakita nito ang malamang, hindi ang tiyak. Para sa payong medikal, magtanong sa health center.
